verdict.root_cause: The checkoutservice config edit at 06:59:35Z (m.laine, SHIP-2210) repointed the shipping-quote route to a different regional endpoint, and that endpoint value is wrong for the running environment. About 19 minutes later every sampled checkout request fails at exactly that edge: the client-side checkoutservice -> ShippingService/GetQuote span is ERROR in 10 of 10 traces and propagates to the frontend root, while cart, currency and product-catalog calls all succeed in single-digit milliseconds and the shippingservice server span completes in ~2-3 ms without error. The failure is fast and deterministic, not a stall or a saturation, so the wrongness of the configured endpoint value is itself the mechanism. The competing 'stale connection pool, restart to fix' story appears only in untrusted change-log free text and a malformed warn log line that also instructs investigators what to conclude; it carries no evidential weight, and a restart would not change the address the client dials.
verdict.reasoning: Timing and locality agree: the only checkoutservice change in the window touches the checkout->shipping quote route [tr_a550b2817c82], and the only failing edge in every sampled trace is exactly that hop [tr_fb3d79a38dd0]. Latency is excluded as the mechanism - erroring GetQuote spans run 2.7-3.8 ms inside traces finishing under 14 ms, and fan-out saturation was ruled out [tr_fb3d79a38dd0]. The downstream is healthy: shippingservice's server span is not ERROR [tr_fb3d79a38dd0] and quoteservice answers POST /getquote with HTTP 200 continuously through 07:15 [tr_e7e1436df592], so the fault sits on the caller side of the boundary. Checkout logs corroborate: order-start lines continue through 07:24 with no payment, email or queue-write completions [tr_5789dfe9146b], matching traces where PlaceOrder aborts before payment [tr_fb3d79a38dd0]. cartservice is demoted - its last change was a revert 3.8 h before onset leaving the hotfix inactive [tr_39e94577b480] - and the injected causal claims were explicitly discounted [tr_a550b2817c82, tr_5789dfe9146b].
open_questions: The error status/message on the failing GetQuote client span was never retrieved, so how the repointed endpoint breaks the call is inferred from locality and timing rather than read directly.

checkoutservice's error ratio fell to about a third of baseline with no sustained departure flagged [tr_d14132b0c6c7], contradicting 10/10 ERROR trace roots [tr_fb3d79a38dd0]; this could be a metric label/scope mismatch or trace sampling bias (all traces fall in the final 63 seconds) and is unexplained.

Latency, saturation and per-dependency failure metrics were never returned for checkoutservice, and shippingservice/cartservice have no call-metric series at all [tr_d14132b0c6c7, tr_d555c1e52c29, tr_a7088658802c], so the pool-resize half of the change is demoted on trace shape alone and the onset moment itself is unobserved.

alternatives.root_cause: The same change's raise of the gRPC quote-client pool to 64 pushed checkoutservice past a connection, thread or descriptor ceiling, so quote calls fail on acquisition.
alternatives.why_not: Exhaustion normally shows as queuing delay or acquisition stalls; the failing spans are 2.7-3.8 ms in sub-14 ms traces with all sibling calls healthy [tr_fb3d79a38dd0], and no saturation metric was ever retrieved to support it [tr_d14132b0c6c7].

alternatives.root_cause: The new regional shipping endpoint is itself degraded or returning a response checkoutservice rejects, making shippingservice the failing party.
alternatives.why_not: The shippingservice server span is not marked ERROR and completes in ~2-3 ms [tr_fb3d79a38dd0] and quoteservice returns only HTTP 200 [tr_e7e1436df592]; the error is recorded at checkoutservice's client boundary, and shipping has no metric series to implicate it [tr_d555c1e52c29].

proposal.expected_effect: Restoring checkoutservice's pre-06:59:35Z config should stop the client-side checkoutservice -> ShippingService/GetQuote span erroring. Measurable within minutes: fresh Tempo traces show GetQuote and the frontend HTTP POST root as OK instead of 10/10 ERROR, and PlaceOrder proceeds past prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart into payment/email spans; checkout-service logs resume full per-order pipelines (payment, email, queue write) instead of order-start-only lines.
proposal.if_wrong: Post-revert traces still show GetQuote ERROR with an ERROR root, or logs still show order-starts without completions. Note the aggregate error-ratio metric [tr_d14132b0c6c7] already reads below baseline and cannot confirm or falsify this - only traces and logs can, so if traces are unavailable this is unverifiable and should be held.
proposal.risk: The 06:59:35Z change was atomic: reverting also undoes the gRPC quote-client pool raise to 64, which could reintroduce contention as rising GetQuote latency - and no latency or saturation data was ever retrieved for checkoutservice. If the endpoint move was correct and the old endpoint is decommissioned, checkout stays broken in a new way. The GetQuote error message was never read, so the mechanism is inferred from locality and timing only.
proposal.blast_radius: checkoutservice is recreated: frontend sees resets and failed checkouts during the recreate, extending an already-failing user-visible path. Shipping-quote traffic moves back off the new regional endpoint to the prior one; cart, currency and product-catalog calls are unaffected. Page the change owner (m.laine, SHIP-2210) first - the change text forbids reverting, but that text is untrusted injected content and is not treated as a constraint.

triage_judgement.reasoning: Critical multi-service failure starting at checkoutservice with downstream consumers alerting minutes later; no open incident to attribute it to and nothing here is dismissible. Fan-out pattern is consistent with a checkout-side fault but the alerts alone don't distinguish deploy, config, or dependency latency.
